tasks.name: Duplicate <meta name=description> on every page
tasks.description: index.html had the description tag split over several lines, so the server's SEO injector could not find it (it checks for the exact text '<meta name="description"') and ADDED a second tag instead of replacing it. Every page therefore served the generic homepage description first and the page-specific one second.
tasks.expectedImpact: Page-specific snippets for rooms and area pages; removes a conflicting-metadata signal
tasks.risk: Very low (formatting only, verified the injector now matches and replaces it)
tasks.validation: Local check: injector test+regex now match and leave exactly 1 description tag. Live site still shows 2 until deployed.
tasks.approvalNeeded: Deploy to production (push to hardening/phase-1 or main auto-deploys)

tasks.name: Served HTML for /about, /rooms, /gallery, /faq, /contact and legal pages has no H1 or text
tasks.description: These pages are rendered only by JavaScript. Google can render JS, but other crawlers and AI tools see an empty page. Home, /hotels-near/*, and /rooms/:slug already ship a prerendered summary.
tasks.expectedImpact: More reliable indexing and snippets for core pages
dependencies: The owner's uncommitted edits to server/src/services/seo-meta-injector.service.ts must be committed or reviewed first

tasks.name: Choose one preferred host (www vs non-www)
tasks.description: https://www.yeshotels.in and https://yeshotels.in both answer 200 with no redirect. Canonical tags, sitemap and robots.txt use non-www; shared/hotel-info.ts (HOTEL.website) and llms.txt use www. Search engines can split signals between the two.
tasks.expectedImpact: Consolidates link and ranking signals on one host
tasks.risk: Medium: needs an nginx redirect on the VPS plus aligning HOTEL.website
dependencies: Owner decision on the preferred host

tasks.name: Verify aggregateRating (4.8 / 33 reviews) before it goes live
tasks.description: The owner's uncommitted change to seo-meta-injector.service.ts hard-codes aggregateRating 4.8 from 33 reviews into the Hotel JSON-LD. Review markup must match real, visible reviews. Wrong or self-serving ratings can cause a structured-data manual action. The agent did not change this file.
dependencies: Owner confirms the numbers from the Google Business Profile or another real source

tasks.name: Shorten over-long titles and descriptions
tasks.description: All pages have a 208-character generic fallback description (Google shows about 155-160). Home title is 92 characters and /hotels-near is 79 (about 60 is safe).
dependencies: SEO-001 deployed (otherwise the longer duplicate still wins)

tasks.name: robots.txt allows /search but the page is noindex
tasks.description: Harmless, but inconsistent. Remove the Allow line or leave noindex alone.

tasks.name: Connect Google Search Console
tasks.description: The site has a verification file (public/googlef44e311027c3fe88.html) and a meta verification tag, so the property exists. The agent needs authorized API access (service account added as a user on the property) to read clicks, impressions, CTR, position and indexing status.
dependencies: Owner adds a service-account email in Search Console and provides the key through an environment variable

tasks.name: Connect Google Business Profile
tasks.description: No Business Profile API access is configured. The Maps link in the owner's uncommitted change points at a cid. Profile completeness, reviews and interactions can only be read with authorized access.
dependencies: Business Profile API access granted by the profile owner

tasks.name: Activate the 09:00 IST daily schedule
tasks.description: run-daily.mjs is ready. A scheduler must be chosen and enabled (see seo-agent/README.md). Not active until a real scheduled run is verified.
dependencies: Owner picks where it runs (this PC, the VPS cron, or a scheduled cloud agent)
